verdict.rationale: Windmill's own docs and llms.txt describe it as open-source and self-hostable, and its source is in a public official GitHub repository (windmill-labs/windmill), so users can read the code. However, no evidence names the license or states its terms, so the 'open license' half of the story is asserted rather than documented. missing for 10: the specific license name and terms (e.g., a LICENSE file citation), clarity on whether any components are under non-open or enterprise licenses, and independent corroboration of the license's openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Windmill is an open-source and self-hostable workflow engine and developer platform
An open-source workflow engine and developer platform to build endpoints
The source-of-truth spec lives in the official windmill-labs/windmill repository (backend/windmill-api/openapi.yaml), versioned with each release.
